provenance.existing_test: TestRegionScore sets region size=1 and asserts RegionScore(v1) is not NaN; does not assert LeaderScore. All score cases are source-derived, not executed Go differential evidence.
provenance.derivation: policy 0 uses signed count+delta; policy 1 uses signed size+delta; divide by math.Max(weight,1e-6); unknown policy returns 0. Signed overflow wraps before float conversion. ResourceCount casts negative signed count to uint64; ResourceWeight clamps only <=0, preserves NaN and tiny positive weights. Setters assign directly; Clone/ShallowClone copy scalar fields.
provenance.resource_case: counts [3,9,2,4,5], sizes [30,90], weights [2,3] round-trip and copy; negative counts -1/-2 project to MAX/MAX-1; witness/unknown projection returns 0; zero defaults; IEEE NaN/infinity and signed extrema derive from source operations.
